evidence: Modifies `src/wallet/test/coinselection_tests.cpp` to properly test Single Random Draw coin selection eviction tie-breaking.
rationale: Fixes a flawed unit test that failed to exercise SRD tie-breaking logic due to passing the wrong UTXO pool and loose weight limits. The PR description notes that the test previously passed even if the tie-breaking logic from #33223 was reverted, making this a worthwhile fix for coin selection regression coverage.
